$comment: The .tdr trial outcome taxonomy: the canonical copy, and the only one.
Every daemon in the family carries its own copy of this table because five
different languages and contexts need it, and nothing but this file says
they are the same table. See INTERACTIONS.md section 6.
This is data, not an IDL, and it is VENDORED rather than depended on: each
repo holds a byte-identical copy and checks its own sources against it in
its own test suite. No build step, no generated files, no shared package,
and a repo that never syncs it simply keeps working.
RULES. The value is the wire contract and is never renumbered: it is in
every .tdr the lab has written and every analysis script that reads one.
Extending is fine; a value once used is used for ever. The NAME is also a
wire contract, because outcomes cross between daemons by name -- so a new
code must land in every copy at once, and a rename is a breaking change to
the same degree a renumber would be.
There is no backwards compatibility with VStim anywhere in braemons. Where
a VStim spelling was wrong it was corrected (code 8), and codes past 10 are

outcomes.name: UNDETERMINED
outcomes.summary: Nothing decided yet - the trial is still in flight.
outcomes.why_not_declarable: A state a trial passes through, not one it ends in. A graph naming it would produce a trial that reported 'still running' for ever.

outcomes.name: NOT_STARTED
outcomes.summary: A start signal was required and never delivered.

outcomes.name: HIT
outcomes.summary: The correct response, in the window.

outcomes.name: WRONG_RESPONSE
outcomes.summary: A response, in the window, and the wrong one.

outcomes.name: EARLY_HIT
outcomes.summary: The correct response on an early-release occasion.

outcomes.name: EARLY_WRONG_RESPONSE
outcomes.summary: The wrong response on an early-release occasion.

outcomes.name: UNEXPECTED_START_SIGNAL
outcomes.summary: A start signal arrived in an interval that is not a start interval.
outcomes.note: VStim misspells this 'Inexpected'. There is no compatibility to keep, so it is spelled correctly here and everywhere. The VALUE is the contract.

outcomes.name: WRONG_START_SIGNAL
outcomes.summary: The wrong start signal was given.

outcomes.name: NEVER_FINISHED
outcomes.summary: The trial was started and nothing ever said how it ended.
outcomes.why_not_declarable: A statement about what the host heard, which no executor is in a position to make. A terminal state declaring 'nobody heard from me' is a contradiction.
outcomes.note: The first code that is not VStim's, and the only one triald assigns to itself. Nothing sends it. See INTERACTIONS.md section 9.7.
